intentEvidence: A modular Obsidian toolkit for startup and quick pages, quick search, inline code copying, updated-time properties, and reading mode locks.
problem: Users need a centralized, modular way to customize core Obsidian workflows, manage note metadata, and integrate external productivity tools.
summary: A modular toolkit providing customizable startup pages, quick search, inline code copying, reading mode locking, and automatic note update time tracking.
